issue.title: Ledger-tools 🔓 glyph on pulled-in ^prj Task Links

task_type_fields.proposal: bob-ledger-tools' read-time 🔓 hand-off glyph (plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/139-unblocked-glyph.js, 271-plugin-unblocked-glyph.js; owned by bob-cli-5w.9) should also mark a live `^prj` Task Link that a close-gesture project pull-in created. Root cause: the glyph model only marks live Task Links under today's open Pomodoros whose task had a `[dependsOn::]` prerequisite completed today; a trigger-(a) pull-in (docs/task-dependencies.md §12.10: the close emptied N, R does not depend on the closed task) has no completed prerequisite, so the pulled-in `^prj` link gets no glyph. Proposal: also glyph a live `^prj` link whose project note had a task completed today and which is EMPTY by the shared predicate (or otherwise derivable at read time without stored state), with a tooltip such as `Project emptied today by ✓ <task>`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Proposed by bob-cli-74.6 note #3. bob-cli-74's plan listed bob-ledger-tools as out of scope; the glyph is a read-time decoration owned by the Successor Links work, and extending its model is a separate plugin change.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-74.6 proposed it: a project pull-in links ^prj under today's Pomodoro, but the read-time hand-off glyph only marks links whose prerequisite closed today.

payload.description: 6v tracks the failing unblocked-glyph tests in the same ledger-tools files
6y adds a project pill in the same ledger-tools ledger decoration area

payload.entry: INTEGRATION (bob-cli-7c land agent): Successor Offers (bob-cli-7c) widens this gap. A picked project-group offer (an open resident of a project whose ^prj the close unblocked) is linked with reason unblocked, but it has no [dependsOn::] on the closed task, so the 🔓 glyph model misses it too, just like a picked project_finished ^prj. Picks also clear [unblocked::] and stamp [fresh:: today], so the glyph cannot rely on those fields. Cover both picked project-group residents and picked ^prj pull-ins.
